activity.role: Chief of the Ineseño Chumash community
activity.notes: Rafael Solares (1822–1890) is documented as chief/leader of the Ineseño (Santa Ynez) Chumash community at Zanja de Cota. ATLAS uses the documented c.1878 portrait context as a representative activity point rather than inventing an unsupported full chiefship interval.

sources.title: Cultural Affiliation and Lineal Descent of Chumash Peoples
sources.citation_text: The cultural-affiliation report captions Rafael Solares as chief of the Ineseño Chumash community at Zanja Cota.

sources.title: People of the Sky: Birds in Chumash Culture
sources.citation_text: The publication identifies Rafael Solares as leader of the Santa Ynez Chumash community in a photograph dated 1878.
